description: China economic compensation N (1 month per year; 6 months or more counts as a year, under 6 months as half; 劳动合同法 第47条), the cap at 3x the local average monthly wage which also limits N to 12 years, 2N for unlawful termination (第87条), one month in lieu of notice (第40条), and unemployment benefit duration 12/18/24 months by insured years (失业保险条例 第17条). Items also list the MOHRSS minimum wages as of 2026-10-01 (Beijing 2,540, Shanghai 2,740, Guangdong tiers 2,680/2,300/2,040, Shenzhen 2,700 CNY a month). Also annual leave by cumulative years (5/10/15 days, 职工带薪年休假条例) and the 1-year labour arbitration limitation date (劳动争议调解仲裁法). China mainland (flk.npc.gov.cn), as of 2026-11-21. General information and estimates only: no legal advice, no representation, no filing; values that could not be verified are flagged in the result, not computed.
